testimonials.text: Bookipix just launched: we'd rather show you real books and real feedback than make up numbers or testimonials. In the meantime, the best way to judge is to compose your own — the preview is at true scale from the very start.

delivery.question: 📦 How long does it take to receive the book?
delivery.answer: Expect generally 1 to 2 weeks between ordering and receiving (production then shipping). This is an estimate, not a contractual commitment: it depends on current production load. Production and shipping tracking is visible at any time from your order space.

photos.question: 📸 Can I add photos?
photos.answer: Yes, you can import as many photos as you like. They're automatically optimized for perfect print quality.

collective.question: 👥 How can my loved ones contribute?
collective.answer: Turn on collective mode: enter your loved ones' email addresses, and each one automatically receives an invitation with their own personal link to add photos and memories, no account needed. You can also copy the link yourself to share it another way. You can track who has contributed, send reminders to latecomers, and set a participation deadline.

author.question: 🖊️ Who writes the text in the book?
author.answer: You — and your loved ones if they contribute. No content is ever generated automatically: the engine only handles the layout of what you write.

payment.question: 💳 How does payment work?
payment.answer: You pay online by card (secure payment via Stripe). The book is only printed once your order is confirmed.

editing.question: 📝 Can I make changes after confirming?
editing.answer: Yes, freely, as long as the order isn't paid: photos, text, layout, and format all remain editable at any time. Once the order is paid, the book is locked — that's what guarantees the printed version matches exactly what you confirmed.

withdrawal.question: ↩️ Can I cancel after placing my order?
withdrawal.answer: No: since your book is composed from your own photos and text, it's a personalized item, excluded from the 14-day right of withdrawal (Article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code). You're informed of this and explicitly accept it before paying, when confirming your order.

blurryPhoto.question: 📷 One of my photos looks blurry, what should I do?
blurryPhoto.answer: Before ordering, a summary screen automatically flags any photo whose resolution is too low for a sharp print at the chosen format. You can then replace it with a larger version, change its layout, or choose to order as-is, knowingly.
